summary: Iteration 129 - Naukri Excel Import Feature Testing. Backend: 10/10 tests PASSED. Frontend: All features verified working. The complete flow (Upload → Parse → Preview → Save → Result) is fully functional. Deduplication correctly merges duplicate candidates.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: POST /api/admin/bulk-import/excel parses 40 candidates from sample Naukri Excel file
VERIFIED: Response includes batch_id, total_rows=40, valid_rows=40, candidates array
VERIFIED: Parsed candidates contain naukri_data with key_skills, notice_period, resume_headline, etc.
VERIFIED: POST /api/admin/bulk-import/save accepts actual candidate dict objects (not indices)
VERIFIED: Save response includes successful, duplicates_merged, failed counts
VERIFIED: Deduplication works - second save returns duplicates_merged > 0
VERIFIED: Created candidates have source='naukri_excel_import' in candidate_bank
VERIFIED: Both endpoints require admin authentication (401/403 without token)
VERIFIED: Frontend Naukri Import page loads at /admin/bulk-import with data-testid='naukri-import-page'
VERIFIED: Upload section visible with file input accepting .xlsx/.xls/.csv
VERIFIED: Parse & Preview button triggers Excel parsing
VERIFIED: Preview shows 40 candidate rows with names, emails, skills badges, notice period
VERIFIED: Import button shows 'Import 40 Candidates' with correct count
VERIFIED: After import, result screen shows 'Import Complete' with Imported/Merged/Failed counts
VERIFIED: Result screen uses correct field names: saveResult.successful, saveResult.duplicates_merged, saveResult.failed
VERIFIED: 'Import Another File' and 'View Candidate Bank' buttons visible on result screen
VERIFIED: Toast notification shows 'Imported X candidates, merged Y'
seed_data_creation: Test imported 5 candidates from sample Excel file during backend tests. Frontend tests imported all 40 candidates. Candidates have source='naukri_excel_import' in candidate_bank collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 129 tested the Naukri Excel Import feature after bug fixes. Two bugs were fixed by main agent: (1) Frontend handleSave was sending integer indices instead of actual candidate objects - now sends filter(c => c.is_valid), (2) Frontend result screen was referencing wrong field names (inserted/updated/skipped instead of successful/duplicates_merged/failed). Both fixes verified working. The sample Excel file 'Senior-Data-Scientis_20260325125105_40.xlsx' with 40 candidates is at /tmp/naukri_sample.xlsx. The candidate_bank collection now has candidates with source='naukri_excel_import' from testing.

tests: POST /api/admin/bulk-import/excel returns 200 with batch_id, total_rows, valid_rows, candidates
Parses 40 candidates from sample Naukri Excel file
Candidates contain naukri_data dict with key_skills, notice_period, resume_headline, etc.
Candidates have required fields: candidate_name, email/contact_no
POST /api/admin/bulk-import/save accepts candidate dict objects (not indices)
Creates candidates in candidate_bank with source='naukri_excel_import'
Second save of same candidates returns duplicates_merged > 0
Duplicates are merged, not created as new records
Parse stats show Total Found, Valid, Invalid, Columns Detected
Each row shows name, email, phone, location, experience, notice period
Import button shows correct count 'Import 40 Candidates'
Import Complete heading displayed after save
